data.body_html:
Choosing between the Azimut 39 and the Sunseeker Predator 55 for your Marbella boat charter depends on group size, budget, and the kind of day you want on the water. Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they differ in length, capacity, price, and onboard vibe. This comparison breaks down the key specs, costs, and best use cases so you can decide which boat fits your Costa del Sol plans.

Size and Capacity

The Azimut 39 measures 12.5 metres and can carry up to 11 passengers. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is larger at 17.4 metres and holds up to 12 people. That extra 5 metres gives the Predator 55 more deck space, a bigger cockpit, and a larger sunpad for lounging. If your group is 10 or fewer, the Azimut 39 is plenty spacious. For a full group of 12, the Predator 55 offers more room to spread out.

Price and Inclusions

The Azimut 39 is part of our Tier A pricing: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours, with skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%) all included. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a premium vessel; pricing is on request via WhatsApp. As a rough guide, expect to pay significantly more than the Azimut 39, especially for full-day charters. Both boats include a licensed skipper and fuel.

Performance and Speed

Both are planing hulls with top speeds around 30–35 knots. The Azimut 39 is lighter and feels more sporty and responsive — great if you enjoy a bit of adrenaline. The Predator 55 is heavier and more planted, offering a smoother ride at speed. For reaching Cala del Faro, Cabo Pino, or Estepona in 20–30 minutes, both are more than capable. If you plan to anchor and swim, the Predator 55's larger deck makes it easier to move around.

Onboard Experience

The Azimut 39 has a sporty, modern interior with a small galley, a cabin, and a cockpit with aft seating. The Predator 55 offers a more luxurious layout: a large sunpad forward, a spacious cockpit with a wet bar, and a stylish saloon with panoramic windows. For a day of sunbathing and socialising, the Predator 55 wins on comfort. For a quick, fun trip with drinks and snacks, the Azimut 39 delivers excellent value.

Best Use Cases

  • Azimut 39: Best for groups of 6–11 who want a sporty, affordable charter with drinks included. Ideal for a half-day trip to Marbella's beaches or a sunset cruise from Puerto Banús.
  • Sunseeker Predator 55: Perfect for groups of 10–12 who want luxury, space, and a premium experience. Great for full-day charters to Sotogrande or Cala Cortés.

Which One Should You Choose?

If your budget is up to €2,299 for 8 hours and your group is 11 or fewer, the Azimut 39 is the smarter choice — you get everything included with no hidden costs. If you want the extra space, higher luxury, and don't mind a higher price tag, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is worth the splurge. Both boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's charter scene. For personal advice based on your date and group size, send us a WhatsApp message — we'll match you with the best option.

Frequently asked questions

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is larger at 17.4 metres, compared to the Azimut 39 at 12.5 metres. The Predator 55 offers more deck space, a larger sunpad, and a bigger cockpit, making it better for groups who want to spread out. The Azimut 39 is more compact and nimble.

How many people can the Azimut 39 and Sunseeker Predator 55 hold?

The Azimut 39 can carry up to 11 passengers, while the Sunseeker Predator 55 typically holds up to 12. Both are well within Marbella's charter limits, but the Predator 55 gives slightly more room per person due to its larger size.

What is the price difference between the Azimut 39 and Sunseeker Predator 55?

The Azimut 39 is priced at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is generally more expensive due to its size and luxury finish; contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Which boat is faster: the Azimut 39 or Sunseeker Predator 55?

Both are planing hulls with top speeds around 30–35 knots. The Azimut 39 feels sportier and more responsive due to its lighter weight, while the Predator 55 is more stable at speed. For most day charters, both are fast enough to reach Cala del Faro or Cabopino in 20–30 minutes.

Can I charter the Sunseeker Predator 55 from Puerto Banús?

Yes, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is available for charter from Puerto Banús through our fleet. Contact us on WhatsApp for availability and pricing, as it is a premium vessel often booked in advance during peak season (June–September).

Which is better for a party: Azimut 39 or Sunseeker Predator 55?

For a party of up to 11, the Azimut 39 is excellent value and includes drinks and snacks. For larger groups (12 pax) who want more deck space, a bigger sunpad, and a more luxurious feel, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is the better choice. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

Do both boats include a skipper and fuel?

Yes, both the Azimut 39 and Sunseeker Predator 55 come with a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT included. The Azimut 39 also includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. The Predator 55 typically includes similar provisions.
